- Engaged heavily Q4 2024 -> Q2 2025; progressed to procurement but stalled in legal/security.
- POC run in May 2025: 2-week POC on Dedicated (small GPU pool) showed good latency and quality vs their baseline, but cost delta vs on-prem was flagged by infra team.

Timeline (key activities):
- 2024-11-06: Intro call (AE Ravi) — expressed interest in private deployment, SOC2/ISO must-haves.
- 2025-02-19: Technical deep-dive (SE Maya) — discussed KV cache, batching, model variants, throughput targets (100 qps sustained, p95 < 120ms).
- 2025-04-07: Security questionnaire submitted; asked for KMS/HSM integration details and audit log retention options.
- 2025-05-08 -> 2025-05-22: 2-week POC exchange (demo tokens, perf logs, Fireflies ff_20250612_aldersys_demo).

- 2025-06-18: Security review — redlines around HSM key control and arch diagrams; infra insists on air-gapped option for research workloads.
- 2025-06-20: Final call with CTO; they inform us they will proceed with internal self-host (vLLM/TGI + TensorRT-LLM optimizations).

Customer quotes / notes from calls:
- "We need absolute control of keys and residency — can't hand that off right now." — CTO
- "Unit economics for our scale lean toward a self-managed inference stack, at least for core clinical models." — Head of Infra

Requirements & priorities observed:
- Latency: p95 <= 120ms for short chat flows; throughput target 75-120 qps depending on model.
- Quality: prefer to run open models fine-tuned in-house (privacy constraints).
- Ops: strong preference for KMS/HSM, long audit log retention (7+ years), SOC2 and ISO27001 compliance evidence.
- Deployment: must support VPC and an eventual on-prem, some teams require air-gapped research environment.

Why we lost / rationale provided by account:
- Primary: cost/TCO at their scale — engineering projection showed 40-60% lower recurring cost with internal GPU fleet + TensorRT optimizations.
- Secondary: security posture — need direct HSM control and air-gapped enclaves not currently supported in hosted flow.
- Tertiary: no internal champion willing to pay premium for managed convenience; infra and finance aligned on self-host.

Follow-up / lessons learned:
- Good fit for mid-size regulated customers if we can demonstrate HSM integrations + clearer TCO for hybrid (dedicated + burst to hosted).
- POC materials: preserve perf traces and fine-grained latency breakdowns; Elm team to extract cost modeling for similar accounts.
- Open ticket: provide a compact comparison doc (hosted vs self-hosted TCO) and a checklist for HSM/network architecture to re-open conversation later.
